notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Norn's Wellspring, causing you to put an oil counter on it and draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
